17:35:32 IST Reason:
3. The trial pursuant to Case Crime No. 0643 of 2018 registered with Police Station Khoda, District Ghaziabad under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code is pending consideration before the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ghaziabad.

4. The petitioner filed an application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure(Cr.P.C.) bearing No. 4465 of 2022, titled as Sudhir Kumar Singh Vs.
State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors. seeking a direction for the time bound disposal of the aforesaid trial.

entities.text:
Sudhir Kumar Singh Vs.
State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said application was disposed of by the High Court with a direction that the trial be concluded within two years from the production of the certified copy of the order.

5. When the trial could not be concluded within the stipulated timeframe, the petitioner filed another application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. bearing No.12087 of 2024 titled as Sudhir Kumar Singh Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors., seeking fresh direction for the time bound disposal of the aforesaid trial.

entities.text: Sudhir Kumar Singh Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said application has been dismissed by the High Court vide impugned order dated 03.07.2024.
6. We see no reason to interfere with the order impugned, more particularly, when the petitioner has already obtained one direction for a time bound disposal of the trial.
In such circumstances, it was not open for the petitioner to keep filing successive petitions/applications for the same purpose so as to obtain repeated orders for time bound disposal.

7. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the present special leave petition stands dismissed with liberty to the petitioner to press before the Trial Court itself for the expeditious and out of turn disposal of the trial and in case, any such application is filed, it is expected that the Trial Court would do the needful looking to the pendency of the older cases as well as the roster and keeping in mind the earlier order Sudhir Kumar Singh vs The State Of Uttar Pradesh on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56487816/
